source.claimText: A compound of formula III: [chem] wherein R1 consists of a branched alkyl with 12 to 20 carbons, R2 consists of a branched alkyl with 12 to 20 carbons, L1 and L2 each consist of a bond or a linear alkyl having 1 to 3 carbon atoms, X consists of S or O, L3 consists of a bond, R3 is selected from ethylene, n-propylene or isopropylene, and R4 and R5 are the same or different, each consisting of a linear or branched alkyl consisting of 1 to 6 carbons; or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

core.note: Formula III: R1-OC(=O)-L1-N(-L2-C(=O)O-R2)-C(=O)-L3-X-R3-N(R4)(R5); L3 is a bond (claim 1), so C(=O) binds X directly.
